mapper.sql: CASE WHEN p.cntrct_ty_cd='TK' THEN to_char(b.bill_dt,'YYYY-MM') ELSE b.atrb_ym END
p.prj_id AS project_id,p.prj_nm AS project_name,p.cntrct_ty_cd AS contract_type, p.stlm_mthd_cd AS basis,p.use_yn
mapper.select: SELECT FROM prj.prj p WHERE p.prj_id=#{id}
SELECT p.prj_id FROM prj.prj p WHERE p.prj_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT b.bill_id FROM bill.bill b WHERE b.bill_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT s.bill_stg_id,s.prj_id AS project_id,s.sply_amt,s.bill_plan_dt FROM prj.bill_stg s WHERE s.bill_stg_id=#{id}

SELECT a.asgn_id,a.dev_id,coalesce(a.cntrct_dev_id,a.dev_id) AS cntrct_dev_id, d.dev_nm AS display_name,actual.mng_no AS management_number,a.asgn_se_cd AS kind,a.bgn_dt AS start_date, m.mm_qty AS source_mm_qty,u.bill_untprc_amt AS price,t.atnd_id,t.work_day_qty, t.rglr_tm_qty AS work_tm_qty,t.ovtm_tm_qty,t.mth_work_day_qty FROM asgn.asgn a JOIN mst.dev actual ON actual.dev_id=a.dev_id JOIN mst.dev d ON d.dev_id=coalesce(a.cntrct_dev_id,a.dev_id) LEFT JOIN asgn.asgn_mth m ON m.asgn_id=a.asgn_id AND m.work_ym=#{month} LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT h.bill_untprc_amt FROM asgn.untprc_hist h WHERE h.asgn_id=a.asgn_id AND h.aply_bgn_dt <= greatest(to_date(#{month},'YYYY-MM'),a.bgn_dt) ORDER BY h.aply_bgn_dt DESC LIMIT 1) u ON true LEFT JOIN bill.dspch_atnd t ON t.asgn_id=a.asgn_id AND t.prj_id=a.prj_id AND t.dev_id=a.dev_id AND t.work_ym=#{month} WHERE a.prj_id=#{projectId} AND a.asgn_stts_cd!='CANCELLED' AND a.bgn_dt < (to_date(#{month},'YYYY-MM')+interval '1 month') AND a.end_dt >= to_date(#{month},'YYYY-MM') ORDER BY a.asgn_id
SELECT o.num_val FROM cmn.oprt_std o WHERE o.oprt_std_id='VAT_RATE' AND o.aply_bgn_ym <=#{month} ORDER BY o.aply_bgn_ym DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT max(c.cls_ym) FROM fin.mth_cls c WHERE c.cls_stts_cd='CLOSED'
SELECT c.cls_stts_cd FROM fin.mth_cls c WHERE c.cls_ym=#{month}

SELECT FROM prj.prj p WHERE p.use_yn='Y' AND p.cntrct_ty_cd IN ('MO','DP') AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM asgn.asgn a WHERE a.prj_id=p.prj_id AND a.asgn_stts_cd!='CANCELLED' AND a.bgn_dt < (to_date(#{month},'YYYY-MM')+interval '1 month') AND a.end_dt >=to_date(#{month},'YYYY-MM')) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bill.bill b WHERE b.prj_id=p.prj_id AND b.atrb_ym=#{month} AND b.bill_stts_cd='CONFIRM')) ORDER BY p.prj_nm,p.prj_id
SELECT b.bill_id,b.sply_amt FROM bill.bill b WHERE b.prj_id=#{projectId} AND b.atrb_ym=#{month} AND b.bill_stts_cd='CONFIRM' ORDER BY b.bill_id
mapper.sql: CASE WHEN p.cntrct_ty_cd='TK' THEN to_char(coalesce(b.bill_dt,s.bill_plan_dt),'YYYY-MM') ELSE b.atrb_ym END

b.bill_id,b.bill_no,b.prj_id,b.bill_stg_id,b.atrb_ym,b.bill_dt,b.sply_amt,b.vat_amt,b.tot_amt, b.bill_stts_cd,b.txinv_no,b.txinv_dt,b.rcpt_plan_dt,b.amnd_yn,b.orgnl_bill_id,b.rmrk_desc, s.bill_plan_dt AS stage_plan_dt,p.prj_nm AS project_name,p.cust_ptnr_id AS customer_id,c.ptnr_nm AS customer_name, p.cntrct_ty_cd AS contract_type,part.bsn_part_nm AS sales_part,part.hq_yn, coalesce((SELECT sum(r.rcpt_amt) FROM bill.rcpt r WHERE r.bill_id=b.bill_id),0)::bigint AS received_amt, (b.tot_amt+coalesce((SELECT sum(x.tot_amt) FROM bill.bill x WHERE x.orgnl_bill_id=b.bill_id AND x.amnd_yn='Y' AND x.bill_stts_cd='CONFIRM'),0))::bigint AS adjusted_total_amt

FROM bill.bill b JOIN prj.prj p ON p.prj_id=b.prj_id LEFT JOIN prj.bill_stg s ON s.bill_stg_id=b.bill_stg_id LEFT JOIN mst.ptnr c ON c.ptnr_id=p.cust_ptnr_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT h.bsn_part_id FROM prj.prj_part_hist h WHERE h.prj_id=p.prj_id AND h.aply_bgn_ym <= ORDER BY h.aply_bgn_ym DESC LIMIT 1) ph ON true LEFT JOIN mst.bsn_part part ON part.bsn_part_id=ph.bsn_part_id
mapper.select: SELECT WHERE b.bill_id=#{id}
SELECT WHERE left(,4)=lpad(#{year}::text,4,'0') ORDER BY b.bill_id
SELECT WHERE b.orgnl_bill_id=#{id} ORDER BY b.bill_id

SELECT (b.sply_amt+coalesce((SELECT sum(x.sply_amt) FROM bill.bill x WHERE x.orgnl_bill_id=b.bill_id AND x.amnd_yn='Y' AND x.bill_stts_cd='CONFIRM'),0))::bigint AS supply, (b.tot_amt+coalesce((SELECT sum(x.tot_amt) FROM bill.bill x WHERE x.orgnl_bill_id=b.bill_id AND x.amnd_yn='Y' AND x.bill_stts_cd='CONFIRM'),0))::bigint AS total, coalesce((SELECT sum(r.rcpt_amt) FROM bill.rcpt r WHERE r.bill_id=b.bill_id),0)::bigint AS received FROM bill.bill b WHERE b.bill_id=#{id}
SELECT count(*) FROM bill.rcpt r WHERE r.bill_id=#{id}
SELECT count(*) FROM bill.bill b WHERE b.orgnl_bill_id=#{id} AND b.bill_stts_cd!='CANCEL'

SELECT d.asgn_id,a.dev_id,d.cntrct_dev_id,p.dev_nm AS display_name,d.work_ym,d.mm_qty, m.mm_qty AS source_mm_qty,d.untprc_amt,d.work_day_qty,d.work_tm_qty,d.ovtm_tm_qty,d.ovtm_amt,d.bill_amt,d.rmrk_desc FROM bill.bill_dtl d LEFT JOIN asgn.asgn a ON a.asgn_id=d.asgn_id LEFT JOIN mst.dev p ON p.dev_id=d.cntrct_dev_id LEFT JOIN asgn.asgn_mth m ON m.asgn_id=d.asgn_id AND m.work_ym=d.work_ym WHERE d.bill_id=#{id} ORDER BY d.bill_dtl_id
SELECT r.rcpt_id AS receipt_id,r.rcpt_dt,r.rcpt_amt,r.rmrk_desc FROM bill.rcpt r WHERE r.bill_id=#{id} ORDER BY r.rcpt_dt,r.rcpt_id

SELECT coalesce(h.rsn_desc,h.clmn_nm,h.data_chg_ty_cd) AS description, h.chg_at AS changed_at,h.chg_user_id::text AS user_id FROM sys.data_chg_hist h WHERE (h.tbl_nm='bill.bill' AND h.obj_rec_id=#{id}::text) OR (h.tbl_nm='bill.rcpt' AND h.rsn_desc='bill_id=' || #{id}::text) ORDER BY h.chg_at DESC,h.data_chg_hist_id DESC
SELECT d.send_at AS sent_at FROM bill.dun_hist d WHERE d.bill_id=#{id} ORDER BY d.send_at DESC,d.dun_hist_id DESC

SELECT AS month,sum(b.sply_amt)::bigint AS confirmed_supply_amt FROM bill.bill b JOIN prj.prj p ON p.prj_id=b.prj_id LEFT JOIN prj.bill_stg s ON s.bill_stg_id=b.bill_stg_id WHERE b.bill_stts_cd='CONFIRM' AND left(,4)=lpad(#{year}::text,4,'0') GROUP BY ORDER BY month
SELECT r.rcpt_dt,sum(r.rcpt_amt)::bigint AS rcpt_amt FROM bill.rcpt r WHERE extract(year FROM r.rcpt_dt)=#{year} GROUP BY r.rcpt_dt ORDER BY r.rcpt_dt

SELECT coalesce(sum(s.sply_amt),0)::bigint FROM prj.bill_stg s JOIN prj.prj p ON p.prj_id=s.prj_id WHERE p.cntrct_ty_cd='TK' AND extract(year FROM s.bill_plan_dt)=#{year} AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bill.bill b WHERE b.bill_stg_id=s.bill_stg_id AND b.amnd_yn='N' AND b.bill_stts_cd!='CANCEL')
SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('bill.bill:' || #{prefix},0))::text
SELECT coalesce(max(substring(b.bill_no FROM length(#{prefix})+1)::bigint),0) FROM bill.bill b WHERE b.bill_no LIKE (#{prefix} || '%') AND substring(b.bill_no FROM length(#{prefix})+1) ~ '^[0-9]+$'

INSERT INTO bill.bill(bill_no,prj_id,atrb_ym,bill_dt,sply_amt,vat_amt,bill_stts_cd,txinv_no,txinv_dt, amnd_yn,orgnl_bill_id,rcpt_plan_dt,rmrk_desc,created_by) VALUES(#{number},#{original.prj_id},#{original.atrb_ym},#{input.bill_dt},#{input.sply_amt},#{input.vat_amt}, 'DRAFT',#{input.txinv_no},#{input.txinv_dt},'Y',#{original.bill_id},#{input.rcpt_plan_dt},#{input.reason},#{actor}) RETURNING bill_id
mapper.update: UPDATE bill.bill SET bill_stts_cd=#{after},updated_by=#{actor},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, cnfrm_user_id=CASE WHEN #{after}='CONFIRM' THEN #{actor} ELSE cnfrm_user_id END, cnfrm_at=CASE WHEN #{after}='CONFIRM' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE cnfrm_at END WHERE bill_id=#{id} AND bill_stts_cd=#{before}
